sources_considered.why: Dated primary announcement comparing GPT-4o's pricing and capabilities with GPT-4 Turbo.
Search identified corroborating launch pricing; the main company announcement was sufficient.
Primary engineering report includes a deployed reduction in GPU requirements, beyond an advertised price cut.
The model was announced after the July 8 post and cannot establish a reduction already achieved during the observation period.
Current documentation can incorporate later pricing and is unsuitable for establishing launch-period prices.

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI announced a halving of API prices and reported comparable English-text and coding performance. This establishes lower customer usage prices, without establishing OpenAI's internal production cost or profitability.

evidence_items.locator: The Silent Hero Behind LMSYS Vicuna and Chatbot Arena, final paragraph
evidence_items.explanation: The deployment report describes serving the referenced April–May traffic with half as many GPUs and states that operational costs fell. This demonstrates a practical efficiency route; it is not a claim that every component of total cost fell by half.

unresolved_gaps: No comprehensive series of fully allocated provider costs was established.
These examples do not determine trends in frontier-model training budgets or total industry spending.
